zh-CN.name: 酒业洞察
zh-CN.description: 酒行业的政策、渠道、营销、消费与企业动态观察。只做数据溯源、结论先行的独立判断，每篇回答一个具体的经营问题——面向酒企品牌方与酒类经销商的决策者。

en.name: Industry Insights
en.description: Independent, sourced analysis of China's liquor industry — policy, channels, marketing and consumer trends, one real business question per piece.

zh-CN.name: 渠道与终端
zh-CN.description: 即时零售、前置仓与同城配送、DMS/B2B 订货、终端管理与供应链履约——渠道数字化怎么落地、坑在哪、账怎么算。主受众：区域经销商、连锁酒行与终端经营者。

en.name: Channels & Retail
en.description: Instant retail, DMS/B2B ordering, outlet management and supply-chain fulfilment — how channel digitalisation lands, where it fails and what it costs.

zh-CN.name: 消费者与会员
zh-CN.description: 消费者运营、会员体系、私域与用户数据资产，以及 CDP／SCRM／CRM 与数据中台的选型与实施经验。主受众：酒企营销、消费者运营与数字化负责人。

en.name: Consumers & Membership
en.description: Consumer operations, membership, private domain and customer data assets, plus hands-on notes on CDP/SCRM/CRM and data platforms for brand teams.

zh-CN.name: 一物一码与防窜货
zh-CN.description: 一物一码、扫码营销、渠道返利、防伪与防窜货——从一个码的建设成本，到动销数据能否真实留痕。主受众：酒企市场与渠道负责人、承担控价控货责任的总代。

en.name: Serialization & Anti-Diversion
en.description: Item-level codes, scan-based marketing, channel rebates and anti-diversion — from the real cost of a code to whether sell-through data is truly captured.

zh-CN.name: 场景增长
zh-CN.description: 宴席酒、封坛酒、定制酒、回厂游与企业团购礼赠——把一个个消费场景做成可以运营的增长入口。主受众：酒企品牌方。

en.name: Consumption Scenarios
en.description: Banquet liquor, sealed cask, custom bottling, distillery tours and corporate gifting — turning consumption occasions into operable growth entry points.

zh-CN.name: 行业动态与技术
zh-CN.description: 酒企新品、渠道变革、组织调整、财报与招投标动态，以及 AI、大模型、营销自动化等可迁移到酒行业的新技术。主受众：酒企与经销商的经营决策者。

en.name: Industry News & Technology
en.description: New products, channel shifts, earnings and tender activity across liquor companies, plus AI and marketing automation transferable to the industry.

zh-CN.name: 解决方案
zh-CN.description: 六类系统能力与三档合作方式：即时零售、扫码营销、定制酒、封坛酒、回厂游、宴席酒。每个页面写清它解决什么问题、适合谁、和哪些业务场景对应。

en.name: Solutions
en.description: Six system capabilities and three ways to engage — instant retail, scan-to-marketing, custom liquor, sealed cask, distillery tours and banquet liquor.

zh-CN.name: 即时零售
zh-CN.description: 同城配送、多门店与前置仓的线上线下一体化：把门店和仓库接上网，让消费者在 30 分钟到 1 小时里买到酒。主受众：区域经销商、连锁酒行与终端门店。

en.name: Instant Retail
en.description: Same-city delivery, multi-store and dark-store operations in one system — bringing outlets and warehouses online for 30–60 minute liquor delivery.

zh-CN.name: 扫码营销
zh-CN.description: 瓶盖码、箱码与渠道返利一体化：让每一瓶的去向可查、动销数据真实留痕，把促销费用发到真正卖货的人手上。主受众：酒企市场与渠道负责人。

en.name: Scan-to-Marketing
en.description: Bottle and carton codes plus channel rebates — every bottle traceable, sell-through genuinely captured, spend reaching those who actually sell.

zh-CN.name: 定制酒
zh-CN.description: 企业礼赠、婚宴纪念与个性化包装的定制下单与生产协同：从选酒、选包装到交付进度都在线。主受众：酒企品牌方与承接企业团购的经销商。

en.name: Custom Liquor
en.description: Custom ordering and production coordination for corporate gifting, wedding keepsakes and personalised packaging, from liquor selection to delivery status.

zh-CN.name: 封坛酒
zh-CN.description: 封坛认购、藏酒管理与取酒转赠的线上化：把窖藏做成可运营的高价值客户资产，而不是一张纸质凭证。主受众：有窖藏能力与高端客户群的酒企。

en.name: Sealed Cask
en.description: Online management of cask sealing, cellar storage, withdrawal and gifting — turning cellar inventory into an operable high-value customer asset.

zh-CN.name: 回厂游
zh-CN.description: 酒庄与厂区参观、品鉴、接待与研学的预约和运营：把一次参观变成可追踪的客户旅程与复购入口。主受众：酒企品牌与市场团队。

en.name: Distillery Tour
en.description: Booking and operations for distillery visits, tastings and study tours — turning one visit into a trackable customer journey and a repeat-purchase entry point.

zh-CN.name: 宴席酒
zh-CN.description: 婚宴、寿宴、升学宴的场景化销售与费用管理：把宴席政策、用酒台账与终端激励放进同一套系统。主受众：区域经销商与承办宴席的终端门店。

en.name: Banquet Liquor
en.description: Scenario-based selling for weddings, birthdays and school banquets — banquet policy, consumption records and outlet incentives in one system.

zh-CN.name: 服务与合作方式
zh-CN.description: 品牌咨询、数字化系统落地、年度顾问三档合作方式，每档写清解决什么问题、交付什么、周期多长、不做什么。

en.name: Services & Engagement
en.description: Brand consulting, digital system delivery and annual advisory — each stating what it solves, what it delivers, how long it takes and what it does not do.

zh-CN.name: 案例
zh-CN.description: 已获授权的项目复盘，按背景、做法、数据与复盘四段呈现；未获授权的一律以“某头部酒企／某区域经销商”代称。

en.name: Case Studies
en.description: Authorised project reviews in four parts: context, approach, results and reflection. Unauthorised engagements are anonymised.

zh-CN.name: 关于我
zh-CN.description: 我在酒行业的从业经历、亲手实施过的系统类型，以及我提供服务的方式与边界。

en.name: About
en.description: My background in China's liquor industry, the systems I have personally delivered, and how I work with clients — including where my expertise ends.

heroTitle.zh-CN: 让酒企的每一分投入，都看得见动销
heroTitle.en: Make every yuan in liquor go where the sell-through is visible

seoMeta.description: 酒业数智增长观察站：酒行业品牌咨询与数字化系统解决方案。监测政策、渠道、营销与消费趋势，输出数据溯源、结论先行的行业判断，服务酒企品牌方与酒类经销商。

A desk tracking digital growth in China's liquor industry: brand consulting and digital system solutions for liquor brands, distilleries and distributors — policy, channels, marketing and consumer trends, with sourced and conclusion-first analysis.
联系酒行业品牌咨询与数字化系统落地服务：告诉我们你遇到的渠道、动销或会员问题，我们会先判断问题值不值得做系统，再谈怎么做。

Talk to us about brand consulting and digital system delivery for the liquor industry. Tell us your channel, sell-through or membership problem — we will first judge whether it needs a system at all, then how to build it.
